title: Dominic and the Radiators
author: Rosalind Blackwood
blurb: Ada Crane, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
